svg.title: Where each function of the tray call tree goes
svg.desc: Four layers: Scheduler keeps orchestration and the single write to ctx; DefaultSolver runs the loop; a private Pass holds the only mutable state; everything else becomes a pure free function.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Today every function here is a Scheduler member (grey comments). After the refactor, mutation is confined to the top layer (writes ctx) and to Pass (private to one Solve call).
